name: Burning observation — Bali, Bali
description:
A small-scale incinerator operates regularly from Monday to Saturday, generally from around 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, producing heavy smoke emissions, at times including visible black smoke. Depending on the wind direction, the smoke disperses into the surrounding area.
